notes: Every verified_statements quote was read on its source page on 2026-09-29, mostly in a real browser because several sites block automated fetchers.
Domains were confirmed from the organization's own pages (listed sending domains, report addresses, or homepage titles). Entries marked 'from prior knowledge' in review_note still need confirmation.

display_names avoid common words and first names (Chase, Citi, Meta, Apple, UPS alone). PayPal, Amazon, Microsoft and Google keep the existing protected-brand rule (display_check), so their names are not matched twice.
gov_suffixes lets a government entry accept that country's government domains (.gov, gov.uk, gc.ca, gov.au). brand_tlds accepts a brand top-level domain (DHL's .dhl).
A matching domain proves nothing on its own because From is not authenticated; the registry is used to detect impersonation.

Service entries (display_check: sender_only) were added on 2026-09-30 to verify these services' own senders. They carry no display names, so they add no impersonation matches; sender_names are product names their own mail uses. domain_sources lists the pages read. Shared or customer-controlled domains (atlassian.net, tumblr.zendesk.com) are excluded.

Cloudflare and Adobe were considered on 2026-09-30 and left out: a user reported fully authenticated phishing sent through notify.cloudflare.com, and Adobe's sending domains were not found on an official page while its share and signature notices are widely abused.

relay_addresses (2026-10-01) are sender addresses that only carry other users' content: GitHub discussion notifications (notifications@github.com, per GitHub's email-notification docs), Google Drive/Docs/Groups/Calendar sharing addresses and Docusign envelope senders (dse*@docusign.net), all seen in Nazario phishing. Mail from them is never an official message.

Entries added on 2026-10-02 (USAA, Fifth Third Bank, PNC Bank, Charles Schwab, MetaMask, Tinder, 三井住友銀行) were read on their source pages in a browser that day, except Tinder, read through a fetch tool. Alibaba.com was added the same day, read in a browser.
